rules.name: Linken's Sphere
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Linken's Sphere: Spellblock blocks most targeted spells once every 14 s (+16 all attributes, +6.5 health and +4.25 mana regeneration). Valve /herodata: Phantom Strike and Charge of Darkness are cast on the target (unit-target behavior), Slark's Pounce is not. It is in his build (25%, ~31 min); against Slark, Phantom Assassin or Spirit Breaker 31% of 59 games (19% otherwise), won 67% against 42%: earlier. The player review (2026-10-20): Linken's against Phantom Assassin and Spirit Breaker, not against Slark.
